source.publisher: Central Elections Committee (ועדת הבחירות המרכזית לכנסת)
source.title: Submitted candidate lists for the 26th Knesset — not yet approved by the CEC
source.notes: Transcribed from the official CEC index page and its 35 per-list roster sub-pages, rendered in a browser (the host returns HTTP 403 to non-browser clients; no protection was circumvented). The index lists 38 submitted lists; 3 publish no roster (הליכוד, השותפות לכולם, שמע) and are recorded in lists[] with rosterPublished=false and zero rows. Source states verbatim: רשימות אלה אינן סופיות וועדת הבחירות המרכזית טרם אישרה אותן — these lists are not final and the CEC has not approved them. ballotLetters are the letter options as submitted and are neither final nor unique across lists (ב, כן, יד and רץ each appear on two lists); they are not an identity key. Names are published as one concatenated string (family name first) and are NOT split into family/given here, because the split is not mechanically derivable — see fullNameHe.
